app.noteWarn: هي APK Google Play مان ناهي — سسٽم شايد وارننگ ڏيکاري؛ اهو متوقع آهي.

app.altMessages: Messages tab in the Serpmonn app
app.trustLine: Free · no ads · Google Play + RuStore
app.faq1q: How is the APK different from the store build?
app.faq1a: It’s the same Serpmonn app. Play and RuStore deliver updates automatically; the site APK helps when a store isn’t available — Android may show a warning, that’s expected.
app.faq2a: Not for news and some tools. An account is required for messages, the findings feed, and profile sync.
app.faq3a: No ads in the app. It’s free to use.
